title: Kulai Half Marathon 2026 Review: JomRun's Johor Mall 21K
seo_title: Kulai Half Marathon 2026 Review | Johor Malaysia Race
meta_description: Kulai Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun: September 20 at AEON Mall Kulaijaya. 21K, 10K, 5K with registration open.
dek: Set for 20 September 2026 at AEON Mall Kulaijaya in Kulai, Johor, this JomRun-powered half marathon offers three distances with registration open.
verdict: The Kulai Half Marathon Powered by JomRun is a convenient, mall-anchored Johor half marathon at AEON Mall Kulaijaya — a practical race hub with parking and facilities. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open via JomRun. Kulai is roughly an hour north of the Singapore border, making it accessible for cross-border runners. September in Johor is the tail of the southwest monsoon. A straightforward Johor half marathon with JomRun's familiar registration experience.
